question: The wave set of hacksaw teeth set has a pitch of ________________.
solution:
The correct answer is __0.8 mm__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Wave set of hacksaw teeth__ refers to the arrangement of the teeth in a wavy pattern.
 
• This arrangement ensures smooth cutting and reduces friction.
 
• The pitch of the wave set is defined as the distance between successive teeth.
 
• The correct pitch measurement for this type of hacksaw teeth set is 0.8 mm.
 
• Using the correct pitch helps in efficient cutting of materials like metal and plastic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hacksaw Blade Types:**

 
 
• Hacksaw blades are available in different types such as flexible, standard, and high-speed steel.
 
• The choice of blade type depends on the material being cut.
 
 
 
• **Blade Tension:**
 
 
• Proper tension is essential to prevent the blade from bending or breaking during use.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Hacksaw:**
 
 
• Commonly used for cutting pipes, rods, and sheets.
 
• Ideal for both manual and powered cutting tasks.
